title: Cooling-system refill and air bleed

operations.label: Refill coolant and bleed trapped air

actions.title: Open the bleed path and refill
actions.instruction: Open the cooling-system air-bleed path and add the specified coolant. Close the bleed path once coolant flows steadily without trapped air at that point.

actions.title: Fill the radiator and reservoir
actions.instruction: Fill the radiator and coolant reservoir to the service-manual levels using the specified premixed coolant.

actions.title: Warm the engine and purge remaining air
actions.instruction: With the heater valve open, run the engine as specified by the service procedure so remaining trapped air can leave the cooling system.

actions.title: Recheck coolant level and leaks
actions.instruction: After the engine is shut off as directed, recheck the coolant level, top up if needed, secure the radiator cap, and check the system for leaks.

boundary_note: Do not include Honda Diagnostic System service-reminder reset steps in this repair. This is the physical refill/air-bleed operation required after water-pump replacement, not a scheduled Maintenance Minder coolant-replacement reset workflow.
